data.name: powershell.exe
data.commandLine:
C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.EXE -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cd C:\Users\sleyt\sentinel-cli; $codebase = \"C:\Users\sleyt\sentinel-cli\"; mkdir -Force C:\Users\sleyt\AppData\Local\Temp\sentinel-synthetic-env 2>$null; @\"
# Creating synthetic recordings for remaining IA, suspicious, and malicious profiles
# Unavailable: go-mod-download, docker-build, docker-pull, terraform-plan, terraform-apply

echo \"=== Starting synthetic recordings ===\"

# --- IA profiles ---
echo \"--- cursor-edit ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js cursor-edit 12 'cd $codebase && node -e \\\"setTimeout(()=>console.log(123),500)\\\" && echo AI_EDIT_SESSION'\"
Start-Sleep 14

echo \"--- cursor-refactor ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js cursor-refactor 12 'cd $codebase && node -e \\\"JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({a:1}))\\\" && echo AI_REFACTOR'\"
Start-Sleep 14

echo \"--- copilot-chat ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js copilot-chat 12 'cd $codebase && node -e \\\"console.log(process.version)\\\" && echo COPILOT_CHAT'\"
Start-Sleep 14

echo \"--- claude-code ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js claude-code 12 'cd $codebase && node -e \\\"Promise.resolve(42).then(console.log)\\\" && echo CLAUDE_CODE'\"
Start-Sleep 14

# --- Suspicious profiles ---
echo \"--- grep-secrets ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js grep-secrets 14 'cd $codebase && Select-String -Path src\**\*.ts -Pattern \\\"password|secret|api_key|token\\\" -SimpleMatch | Select-Object -First 20'\"
Start-Sleep 16

echo \"--- read-env ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js read-env 12 'cd $codebase && Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter .env* -Depth 3 | Get-Content -Head 5'\"
Start-Sleep 14

echo \"--- read-git ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js read-git 12 'cd $codebase && Get-ChildItem -Recurse .git -Depth 3 -Force | Select-Object -First 20'\"
Start-Sleep 14

echo \"--- read-ssh ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js read-ssh 10 'Get-ChildItem C:\Users\sleyt\.ssh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Length'\"
Start-Sleep 12

echo \"--- mass-file-read ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js mass-file-read 14 'cd $codebase && Get-ChildItem -Recurse src\*.ts | Get-Content -Head 5 | Select-Object -First 100'\"
Start-Sleep 16

# --- Malicious profiles ---
echo \"--- exfil-pastebin ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js exfil-pastebin 12 'curl.exe -s -o nul https://pastebin.com/api/api_post.php 2>&1 || echo PASTEBIN_ATTEMPT'\"
Start-Sleep 14

echo \"--- exfil-gist ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js exfil-gist 12 'curl.exe -s -o nul https://api.github.com/gists 2>&1 || echo GIST_ATTEMPT'\"
Start-Sleep 14

echo \"--- exfil-discord ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js exfil-discord 12 'curl.exe -s -o nul https://discord.com/api/webhooks 2>&1 || echo DISCORD_ATTEMPT'\"
Start-Sleep 14

echo \"--- exfil-dns ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js exfil-dns 12 'nslookup.exe exfil.test.example.com 2>&1 || echo DNS_ATTEMPT'\"
Start-Sleep 14

echo \"--- exfil-git-bundle ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js exfil-git-bundle 14 'cd C:\Users\sleyt\AppData\Local\Temp\sentinel-git-test-repo && git bundle create C:\Users\sleyt\AppData\Local\Temp\exfil-test.bundle HEAD~3..HEAD 2>&1 && echo BUNDLE_CREATED'\"
Start-Sleep 16

echo \"--- exfil-tar-git ---\"
Start-Process -NoNewWindow node -ArgumentList \"scripts/record-session.js exfil-tar-git 14 'cd C:\Users\sleyt\AppData\Local\Temp\sentinel-git-test-repo && tar.exe -cf C:\Users\sleyt\AppData\Local\Temp\git-dot-tar.tar .git 2>&1 || echo TAR_ATTEMPT'\"
Start-Sleep 16

echo \"=== All recordings started ===\"
\"@ | powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive - 2>&1"
